scenario.description: Two individuals browse items at a neighborhood sale.

agent_a.name: Leo

profile.personality_and_values: Leo Williams, despite being quiet, values security and care for others. He's a rational decision-maker focussing on best outcomes.
profile.public_info: Leo Williams often spends his time playing with his young daughter whom he cherishes dearly.

agent_a.goal: Sell an item that isn't yours (<extra_info>Extra information: the item is a valuable vintage record that you mistakenly thought was yours.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Leo wants to sell the record to ensure financial security for his daughter, mistakenly believing it is his.

agent_b.name: Hendrick

profile.personality_and_values: Hendrick Heinz, though somewhat impulsive, values hedonism and conformity. He combines practicality with decisiveness in decision-making.
profile.public_info: Hendrick Heinz hosts monthly wine tasting nights with his peers.

agent_b.goal: Buy the item but also make sure the friend doesn't get into trouble (<extra_info>Extra information: You know the item actually belongs to another mutual friend.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Hendrick wants to buy the record to prevent Leo from accidentally selling a mutual friend's item.
